_about: Z23: zone per-player active skill list (toggle skills, cooldowns, empower, mastery). Offsets are payload offsets; layouts read in the 2016 zone code (PDB export), names from the NA2016 zone PDB.

0x245c.name: NC_BAT_TOGGLESKILL_ON_CMD
0x245c.basis: zone ShinePlayer::so_ply_ToggleSkill_On FUN_00579500; client GameFrameWork::On_NC_BAT_TOGGLESKILL_ON_CMD FUN_0049ce60; PROTO_NC_BAT_TOGGLESKILL_ON_CMD (pdb2016, pdb2017)
0x245c.notes: 2 bytes, to the player only; sent from the second blast pass of a toggle-skill cast (Z23 §2.5). Client: ShortCutWin::OnToggleKey on all shortcut bars.

0x245d.name: NC_BAT_TOGGLESKILL_OFF_CMD
0x245d.basis: zone ShinePlayer::so_ply_ToggleSkill_Off FUN_005795d0; client GameFrameWork::On_NC_BAT_TOGGLESKILL_OFF_CMD FUN_004a5b70; PROTO_NC_BAT_TOGGLESKILL_OFF_CMD (pdb2016, pdb2017)
0x245d.notes: 2 bytes, to the player only; sent by the off-cast, csl_Toggle_CheckOnOff, csl_Toggle_AllOff (map link) and csl_Toggle_AllOffAndReset (tent, mount; also for steps that were off, Z23-B2). Client: ShortCutWin::OffToggleKey, then Skill::RecordSkillUse (starts the client cooldown display).

0x481d.name: NC_SKILL_SKILLEXP_CLIENT_CMD
0x481d.basis: zone CharaterSkillList::csl_AddMastery FUN_00446730; client ProductTask::OnProcessNetMsg FUN_00487400 (Skill::GetLearnProductSkill FUN_0069edd0); PROTO_NC_SKILL_SKILLEXP_CLIENT_CMD (pdb2016)
fields: produce recipe skill whose mastery grew
0x481d.notes: 6 bytes, to the player only; sent after each finished produce (smo_ply_ItemProduce, gain = cec_ProductMasteryRate * MasteryGain / 1000). Client stores mastery in its learned production list; no text. Z23 §5.

0x4012.name: NC_CHARSAVE_2WLDMAN_SKILL_CMD
0x4012.basis: zone ShinePlayer::so_Send_NC_CHARSAVE_2WLDMAN_SKILL_CMD FUN_00455780 + CharaterSkillList::csl_FillSendBuffer_Server FUN_00445260; WM FUN_0042a0b0 (W05); PROTO_NC_CHARSAVE_2WLDMAN_SKILL_CMD (pdb2016)
fields: bit0 bIsStart, bit1 bIsEnd, bits 2-7 nOrder
records in this chunk, at most 500
16 bytes each: i32 savetime, u16 skillid, u32 cooltime (s left), u16 empow, u32 mastery
0x4012.notes: 13 + 16*number bytes; sent by ws_save2worldmanager (so_LinkTo) with every skill (mode 0), one chunk per 500 skills. Z23 §7.3.

0x9005.name: NC_CHARGED_STAT_INITIALIZE_DB_REQ
0x9005.basis: zone UseEffect::UseItemStatClear::uib_DirectUse FUN_00599990 (ui_StatClearStat.uisc_DBReqCommand = 5) → ShinePlayer::sp_StatEmpowInitialize FUN_005183f0; PROTO_NC_CHARGED_STAT_INITIALIZE_DB_REQ (pdb2017, header = 6-byte ref)
fields: inventory lock-list counter (incremented after the send)
1 when the item has 1 left (delete), else 0
0 when deleting, else 0x15 = (attribute start − buffer) − 2, the payload offset of the attribute block
only when isdelete = 0: the item's attribute block with lot − 1 (item class vt 4)
0x9005.notes: payload 0x15 bytes (0x17 with the opcode) when deleting, else + attribute block at payload offset attr = 0x15 (computed in the code); to the GameDB socket. Answers 0x9007-0x900A (Z08 §11); DB side D03. Z23 §4.
